pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with softened edge gradients. Individual patch area is significantly greater on the upper neck and shoulder, reducing into smaller, more rounded shapes toward the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored negative space forming an interconnected grid. Junction nodes typically connect three to four pathways, with pathway thickness varying between 5 and 15 pixels across the visible field.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette is visible along the superior neck contour, appearing as a series of short vertical protrusions.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A notable structural discontinuity or depression in the mane line is present at the junction between the neck and the shoulder.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, dense, fibrous appendage is positioned horizontally across the central flank, creating a temporal occlusion of the underlying pelage geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: Two small, dark, avian-shaped silhouettes are visible clinging to the lateral surface of the neck and shoulder area.
